· RSI trajectory (57.3→55.7): neutral sustained, cooling from overbought signal
· MACD histogram trajectory (15896.2342→3134.9344): improving, bullish expansion signal

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, buy entry condition met on breaking 1,890,000 KRW resistance
